svg.text: See your VRAM before it runs out — inside RimWorld.

text.tspan: RimWorld draws the game while a local language model runs in the
background. Both live in the same VRAM — and when it fills up, the
model spills to system RAM and your framerate and tokens crater.

svg.text: Live VRAM breakdown — measured total, estimated split

text.tspan: VRAM, temperature, power, clocks, fan —
read straight from NVML.
Splits used memory into System /
RimWorld / your local model.
Warns you before the model spills out of
VRAM and stalls.
A toggleable in-game HUD and a full
stats window.
Reads the loaded model and estimates its
VRAM footprint.
A model on another machine is detected,
never counted local.
RimWorld now hosts local LLMs (RimTalk, the RimSynapse suite, and more) — the game
and the model share one pool of VRAM.
Running out of VRAM is the #1 failure: the model spills to system RAM and
everything slows by an order of magnitude.
This makes VRAM visible so you can right-size your model and context window — real
numbers instead of guesswork.
Works with any local LLM served over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. No dependency
on any specific mod.

svg.text: Standalone · requires only Harmony · reads NVIDIA's NVML library · zero save-file footprint
Independent community mod — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by NVIDIA Corporation.
